note: Everything written once: the palette of spec 2026-09-04 §3.8 (steel and cold light, orange for attention), the SDF face at a few sizes, spacing, control heights, the device geometry. Descriptions under ui/OpenZone_PDA refer to these as $color.name, font names, $space.name, $size.name, $device.name. The contacts tab is shared by two pages of two mods: $device.contacts is the left side (this mod), $device.satellite the right one, the faction page of OpenZone_Factions_PDA, which reads these same tokens through its own [build] tokens. A pair has no components: $device.pageW is not a slice of $device.page, so every number the shell needs on its own -- railEdge (the rail plus its one-unit edge), screenH, pageW -- is a scalar in its own right.
